target: Derive a formal or quantitative account of sparse experts using a gated-expert routing study. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

competency.title: Derive sparse experts — field data
competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of sparse experts using a gated-expert routing study. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

topic_kernel.measure: expert load balance and token quality
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: expert collapse behind a high average score

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a gated-expert routing study.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include the data card, missingness check and permitted use.
Report expert load balance and token quality with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: expert collapse behind a high average score.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of sparse experts.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report expert load balance and token quality against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for expert collapse behind a high average score; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
